criteria.condition: Edge pan, horns, UI, focus and boundaries
criteria.assessment: Final runtime: four directions and two opposite corners, actual pick controls, reparated tray, right/ the middle man, cancel/focus Loss, rastra and detach boundaries. No change in projection or command.

Final runtime: empty and busy region, units/characters/Druynia and the former region after Mordor. Terrain metadata does not give tooltipu, click gives the current lineup; pan/fokus does not open the region. Final Editor25 confirms the priority of the hiver < selection < legal target/attack.

criteria.condition: Information hover/fokus; interactive panels of all families click/Enter/Space
criteria.assessment: Final tests 24/25 cover text description, four systems, stability figures/trays/stage and representatives klik/keyboard. A Exhausting Family Passage Cards/Politics/Characters/Effects/Victory/Fellowship/Hunt/sovereign Help and full form directory has XML22 : tooltip is already final, but the deal is pre-budget booking. Do not call these XML 25. Later drivers24 check the geometry and gestures of all their 40 + 32 options.

criteria.condition: Tooltip does not capture gesture; priority action, no additional Confirm/GET/POST, privacy
criteria.assessment: Final runtime: physical double-click of both roles, one POST/receipt, privacy cards and Fellowship, cancel/capture/wheel and one Esc. The GET countdown is with XML22, which RuntimeTooltip is identical to the final; the repeat tests24 do not change its contract. Full cancellation of the map drag at the new revisions/reconnect is the earlier XML13, not the new run.

criteria.condition: Targets without arrows/options, armies/attack/routes and their final
criteria.assessment: Final runtime confirms march, actual attack by ArmyGestures .Target and Strider's journey with two clicks of the same terrain (choice/final) with the exact cost. XML13/14/16 covers both sides, click/drop , press without command , illegal target, no map-target/placement-ghost/Confirm and history without labels/button s. MapDraftOverlay/MapRenderer and controllers army/dr dice/ Fellowship are unchanged from13; however, this is not a re-uptake of all these tests. FigureMotionNetworkTests they use the Post and are proof of animation, not the new gesture of the tour.
remaining_acceptance_work: Final visual inspection of native build/profile UI-77 should confirm the absence of arrows; they were not included in this audit.

criteria.requirement: Both panels without collision in four systems
criteria.finding: The Fellowship/Hunt pair has a common upper edge, separate areas and accessible controls; current public tracks have re-imported24 after tooltip revision. The geometry of the panels and USS import21 remain identical in import25.

criteria.requirement: Close, positions, new decisions and reconnect
criteria.finding: Manual position survives reconnect, reset restores pair, Close survives refresh, new own decision retains proper auto-open; costs and draft are not changed by inspection.

criteria.requirement: Exchangeable rasters, readable Types/piles and stable ID
criteria.finding: The board atlas has 12 named interchangeable sprites; Fellowship atlas 8. The model uses unit:/character: + public ID; graphics and counters have separate geometry. UI76 documents the actual viewing of both scales; in this audience no images were re-viewed and no new PNG Player was counted.

The actual accepted movement is seen by both players, the test measures a different intermediate position and checks the target true marker after completion at FitZoom. Split/merge is concerned with the exact ID and retains the left army. Time/FPS the final native Player has not yet been measured.

criteria.requirement: Hidden Fellowship, reconnect, new projection, Reduced motion
criteria.finding: No regional movement at hidden Progress; separation at unknown position is only an accent of the revealed target. Reruns, continuity of revisions, reconnect and new snapshot do not reproduce the old route. Reduced motion has no translation. Full final native proof still awaits.

structure_review.method: Read-only cross-review integration and structure for the coordinator. The agent tho-created UI-74/UI-80; this is not an external audit of the entire code.
structure_review.conclusion: No blocking defects of structure, layer breaches or new path revealing private data in over-the-counter changes have been found. Profile and native viewing require separate evidence of UI-77.

layers_and_responsibilities.assessment: Diff src is empty. Camera, animations, tooltip and window coordinator do not follow the rules, RNG nor the sender. TurnInteraction continues to direct the finished action to the existing CommandSender.

CameraState centralizes cover/clamp/TryFrame; MapEdgePan is responsible for continuous scrolling; RegionHover separates the highlight from the open. MapDraftOverlay retains legal regions without parallel target menu.

Map/Figures separates the public snapshot ID, the projection difference, the silhouette directory and animation. Differentity requires the same game/Perspectives and revision +1. Unknown source of separation gives only arrival, without playing a secret route.

FellowshipHuntLayout/PairedPanelPlacement they manage geometry, WindowLayout manual session positions. FellowshipTrackState reads public values, and FellowshipTrackRow update fixed cells; not added command Or the domain limit.

RuntimeTooltip uses one subscription cycle and an uninteractive label; rejects text fields and terrain, does not capture Esc. The ActionProgress booking depends on your chosen dice, without displaying an unset budget.

duplication_and_readability: Removed double Observe/Show in hands and sources cards retain one opening owner. HandView keeps his hand over the memorized preview, so the second click hits the same object.

The new components have narrow liability. Two atlas loaders repeat minor validation/cache, but maintain separate closed contracts 12 figures and 8 symbols; no additional common abstraction is currently needed.

Existing composers are large: TurnInteraction 856, BoardScreen 544, MapCanvas 508 line. New directories, layouts and controllers restrict further growth, but further functions should retain this division.

Historical names of DrawerHover/PoliticalHover/BattleWindowHover and some of the preserved parameters/no-op CloseTransient require consistent documentation. Possible naming orders should include the entire API and calls.

hot_paths.assessment: RuntimeTooltip makes a panel.Pick and a short parental walk; the timer 50 ms only works when an open description is given. FocusIndicator checks Pick every 16 ms only with a tracked seal and protects reentrants after changing the layout.

MapEdgePan timer 16 ms works only on the exposed edge, stops at the border and limits the delta to 50 ms. MapRenderer retains geometry and transformation of the entire group. MapCanvas.Refresh still counts distribution/collisions markers: O(markers × occupied rectangles), an important measurement target of dense board.

Snapshot/diff and grouping take place on a new projection; Tick moves existing group transformations. Timer finishes work after the last flight, reconnect/reset removes flights. revealedRegions maintains a clear score for the next projection.

Atlases/sprite are cached; images PickingMode.Ignore do not define hitboxes. Hand/markers/tory keep controls. The pair coordinator has a guard reentranty and compares positions before writing; budget booking prevents a reflow in the middle of the figures selection.

risks_and_limits.item: Large composers and historical names Hover is a maintenance debt; no current behavioral error resulting from these names has been found.
The static review does not confirm 60 FPS or feedback ≤100 ms. Player profile and images start/middle/finished belong to a separate acceptance coordinator.
Windows/Intel runtime, physical smooth, hand-held lot and implementation remain uncounted.
